fns.desc: In the CRYPTO_RSA_OAEP_SHA256 encrypted-identity branch of eap_sim_process_start, username = sim_get_username(...) at line 619 is not freed if the subsequent os_memdup() for new_id fails at line 624-627 (goto failed only frees dec, not username) — leaks username on this OOM error path.

eap_sim_msg_init()'s return value is never NULL-checked before use in all 4 message builders (eap_sim_build_start:112, eap_sim_build_challenge:250, eap_sim_build_reauth:292, eap_sim_build_notification:327) — an allocation failure (msg==NULL, or internally msg->buf==NULL) leads to a NULL/invalid dereference inside eap_sim_msg_add()/eap_sim_build_encr(). Low severity (OOM-only, not attacker-controlled), but a real unchecked-allocation gap.
